title: Acrylic
body_html:
Acrylic
Explore different types of acrylic and learn how material composition, thickness, color, and surface finish affect laser cutting and engraving results.
Clear Acrylic
Transparent acrylic for displays, signage, lighting, awards, and decorative applications.
Colored Acrylic
Transparent, translucent, and opaque sheets for signage, decoration, and custom products.
Mirror Acrylic
Reflective acrylic with a decorative mirror finish for signs, displays, and personalized products.
Frosted & Matte Acrylic
Diffused and low-reflection surfaces for decorative, lighting, signage, and privacy applications.
Cast Acrylic
Acrylic produced by casting, generally preferred when engraving quality and detail are important.
Extruded Acrylic
Consistent sheet material often selected for precision cutting and general fabrication.
Acrylic Materials
Acrylic is available in different manufacturing methods, colors, thicknesses, and surface finishes. Choose a material based on the appearance and processing result you need.
Cast Acrylic
Recommended when engraving quality, fine detail, and a frosted engraving appearance are important.
Extruded Acrylic
Often selected for consistent thickness, precision cutting, and general fabrication.
Clear Acrylic
Commonly used for displays, awards, windows, lighting components, and transparent enclosures.
Colored Acrylic
Available in transparent, translucent, and opaque colors for signs and decorative products.
Mirror Acrylic
Reflective acrylic designed for decorative signage, displays, lettering, and personalized products.
Specialty Acrylic
Includes frosted, matte, fluorescent, glitter, and textured acrylic products.
